SQL: select t3.diagnosisname from ( select t2.diagnosisname, dense_rank() over ( order by count(*) desc ) as c1 from ( select patient.uniquepid, diagnosis.diagnosistime from diagnosis join patient on diagnosis.patientunitstayid = patient.patientunitstayid where diagnosis.diagnosisname = 'third spacing' and to_char((diagnosis.diagnosistime)::timestamp, 'YYYY') >= '2105' ) as t1 join ( select patient.uniquepid, diagnosis.diagnosisname, diagnosis.diagnosistime from diagnosis join patient on diagnosis.patientunitstayid = patient.patientunitstayid where to_char((diagnosis.diagnosistime)::timestamp, 'YYYY') >= '2105' ) as t2 on t1.uniquepid = t2.uniquepid where t1.diagnosistime < t2.diagnosistime and date_trunc('month', (t1.diagnosistime)::timestamp) = date_trunc('month', (t2.diagnosistime)::timestamp) group by t2.diagnosisname ) as t3 where t3.c1 <= 3

SQL: select t1.celllabel from ( select intakeoutput.celllabel, dense_rank() over ( order by count(*) desc ) as c1 from intakeoutput where intakeoutput.cellpath like '%intake%' and to_char((intakeoutput.intakeoutputtime)::timestamp, 'YYYY') = '2105' group by intakeoutput.celllabel ) as t1 where t1.c1 <= 3
